Name: You
Text: Grandpa! The skeletons have been defeated!

Name: Grandpa
Text: I can feel it.. the water is rushing back!

Name: Grandpa
Text: Listen! Can you hear it? The rivers of Biringan are alive again!

Name: You
Text: We did it. Biringan is saved.

Name: Grandpa
Text: You have shown incredible courage and wisdom, my child.

Name: Grandpa
Text: The trees will bloom again. The crops will grow.

Name: Grandpa
Text: Biringan will never forget what you have done today. Thank you.
